## Warlock
The Warlock is a tier three psychic caste focused on ranged disruption, corpse harvesting, and battlefield control.
## Core Abilities - Psychic Blast: your baseline ranged psychic burst. - Psychic Crush: creates a growing crushing field which can be released early. - Psychic Shield: raises a directional barrier that can be detonated in front of you. - Psy Drain: harvest a dead humanoid body for hive psy points and larva pressure.
## Mutation Chambers - Shell chambers unlock Cautious Mind. - Spur chambers unlock Draining Blast. - Veil chambers unlock Mobile Mind.
## Primordial After maturing, the Warlock becomes Primordial and gains access to Psychic Lance through its blast mode selector.
